questions.question: Suppose an image-capture subsystem intermittently stops responding after several hours in the field. How would you design the embedded controller architecture and diagnostic strategy to isolate and recover from the fault?

Have you created a PCB design from requirements through schematic, placement, layout review, and fabrication output? Please distinguish clearly between work you personally performed and work you reviewed or tested.
Which development environments have you used to build, flash, debug, and version embedded software? Describe the workflow you would establish when joining a team that uses an unfamiliar IDE.
What microprocessor- or microcontroller-based hardware have you personally worked with, and what was your specific responsibility in its design, programming, bring-up, or test?

Please write or describe a small C routine for an interrupt-driven peripheral interface that safely shares data with a main loop. Explain your choices around volatile data, buffering, timing, and error handling.

A PCB designer asks for guidance on routing a board containing a microcontroller, image sensor interface, power regulators, and fast digital lines. What placement and routing constraints would you provide, and why?

Describe a microcontroller project you have built or supported, including the device family, peripheral interfaces, firmware structure, debug method, and the outcome. If you have not done one, explain how you would approach learning and delivering it.

What experience, if any, do you have with Texas Instruments Code Composer Studio? If it is new to you, outline how you would bring up, build, flash, and debug a TI microcontroller project during your first week.

How would you partition responsibilities between an FPGA and a microcontroller in a high-throughput image-capture system, particularly for timing-critical acquisition, buffering, configuration, and diagnostics?
Describe the most complex digital circuit or electronic assembly you have diagnosed or tested. How did you move from the schematic and observed symptoms to a defensible root-cause conclusion?

questions_rich.question: Suppose an image-capture subsystem intermittently stops responding after several hours in the field. How would you design the embedded controller architecture and diagnostic strategy to isolate and recover from the fault?
